purpose: Production device proof signer for the journal genesis design (design doc section 2), plus its host cross-tests. Host-only work: the Fire HD was not contacted (no adb, no installs, no settings).
execution_form: Single dependency-free Java class compiled to a dex, run on-device via /system/bin/app_process from the root (magisk) shell through snusnu-proof-signer.sh; the same source runs on the host JVM for cross-tests. JCA ECDSA P-256 / SHA256withECDSA, identical stack to the app-side verifiers.

host_tests_2026-11-01.new_module: test_execute_firehd10_device_signer_host_20261101: 9 unittest methods, all PASS (keygen overwrite refusal + pin roundtrip, report mode pass/fail, pinned key accepts production signer and rejects foreign key, genesis end-to-end to READY:<boot>:191, genesis token gates absent/wrong-boot/consumed, routine completion end-to-end via proof_request with tampered-drop denial and replay denial, cross-domain rejection both directions at verifier and journal level, all signer gate denials incl. su timeout, fixup plan + drop shape)
host_tests_2026-11-01.baseline_regression: 60/60 OK (the 59 baseline tests of the v1 manifest, 9 modules, + the v2 bootstrap module), python3.14 -m unittest

label_fixup: Signer copies the SELinux label of a journal-family file in the app DPS files dir (genesis challenge state first) onto the delivered drop via ls -Z + chcon, after chown u0_a55; fixup failure deletes the drop and fails the run. Host-tested in plan mode (FIXUP_PLAN lines); on-device equality is a mandatory genesis-session check (runbook steps 18-20).
